numeric_policy.endpoint: Both printed endpoints included;N2 uses heading>=3526 OR heading<=75
numeric_policy.normalization: No input normalization,rounding,truncation or interpolation. Modulo3600 is used only for explicit uncertainty ranges and differences,not to repair input.
numeric_policy.uncertainty: Integer symmetric radius0..1800 around every primary/alternate/asserted candidate;enumerate entire discrete circle,union deduplicated;stable possible labels in printed source order
numeric_policy.midpoints: Two central valid points per150-point interval. Exact geometric midpoint is an odd count of0.05degrees and remains unsupported as a heading input.

frame_policy: Omitted frame/role remains unknown in effective fields;raw request omissions preserved. Numeric table lookup still works.
source_diagram+source_heading is a complete documentary frame;not a physical measurement.
Magnetic/true declarations remain user-attributed;neither is converted or certified compatible with an unverified physical source convention.
source_diagram with a physical role is incompatible for physical interpretation;unknowns remain missing evidence.
All physical-building,outcome and calibrated-orientation conclusions remain unsupported.
Door,observer,building-facing and sitting are distinct;no heading or building identity inferred from prose.
conflict_policy: Two distinct known asserted values including declaration mark explicit conflict. Unknown never fills a missing declaration.
Conflicting numeric assertions are also evaluated as additional bearing candidates;no definitive ID when any structured contradiction exists.
Independent facing/sitting declarations must differ by1800tenths when both given under the single declared frame;failure is a consistency conflict,not a new source omen.
Primary reading must agree with a same-role independent declaration when supplied. No absent opposite bearing is generated.
comparison_policy: Readings retain their roles/frames. Same building only when equal explicit nonempty building_id is supplied. Angular difference/opposition is editorial and withheld across unknown/different north references;no physical interpretation follows.
supported: All24source labels and discrete interval classification
Reference lookup by exact ID/name/Chinese/source label and neighboring source rows
Entire-range uncertainty and explicit alternate/contradictory readings
Manual side-by-side comparison without inferred shared building
Offline immutable JSON/Markdown and raw-text replay
experimental: Other LuoPan rings,EightMansions,FlyingStars,FormSchool,SanHe/SanYuan andBTB remain research only;no runtime implementation
unsupported: True/magnetic declination conversion or compass calibration
Other FengShui schools,calendar or FlyingStars generation

rights.excluded: Source PDF,artwork,layout,branding,protected book text and creative illustrations
